coordinate_operations_used.description: Inverse of UTM zone 36S + Arc 1950 to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)

notes: The maize identity is established by the campaign metadata; this public shapefile has no per-row crop column.

The actual .prj is EPSG:20936, not EPSG:4326 as stated in the generic metadata CSV. The derived locations/GeoJSON are transformed using the actual .prj to EPSG:4326. The datum operation used is Inverse of UTM zone 36S + Arc 1950 to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization) (44 m accuracy); this is operation accuracy, not measured GPS error. Verify boundary alignment before extracting 10 m satellite pixels.
AVG_YLD is used as the field-average crop-cut yield, interpreted in tonnes/ha based on the campaign dictionary/methodology. The public subset does not expose the individual cuts for recalculation.
The public file has 529 rows, whereas the project narrative reports 523 sampled fields. No extra rows are arbitrarily removed to match the narrative.
The downloaded metadata explicitly states Creative Commons By Attribution (CC BY), despite the catalogue page lacking a licence.
